scenes.card: Program admins and viewers|What you can do
scenes.text: This guide is for team members who were given access to programs, polls or businesses.

scenes.title: Access to what you were given
scenes.text: A program admin can manage only the items they were given. A viewer can only look at them.

scenes.title: What stays with admins
scenes.text: A program admin cannot agree to the platform fee or make refunds. Those belong to an organization admin.

scenes.title: Your own space
scenes.text: You can start a space of your own, where you are the admin, without losing the access you were invited to, and you can leave an organization at any time.
